title: A damaged user pip cache breaks the engine install, and Repair engine is unreachable without a live engine

summary: Shipped in v1.4.4. pip now caches inside the engine (PIP_CACHE_DIR), a failed curated pass records its reason on disk so a cold app can offer Repair, and the Engine health section actually hides - the spec that missed it asserted the hidden property, not computed display, and was verified failing before the fix. Reporter confirmation still owed.
